t: Automatic Folder Organizer: a plain-language overview (Signature)
title: Automatic Folder Organizer: a plain-language overview (Signature)
description: Signature record. Overview: what the Automatic Folder Organizer does and why archives need it. Signature original. The Signature folder steward files by stamped rules: every move records which rule fired and why, and a full dry run always comes first. Mistakes are undone from the journal, not hunted down by hand. The archive's shelves stay in order.
demo:
# Automatic Folder Organizer - runnable demo (JAH-ATK171S-000001)
import re
RANK = 1
SIG = True
FILES = ['invoice_march.pdf', 'photo1.jpg', 'notes.txt', 'app.py', 'scan.png']
RULES = [(r"\.pdf$", "Documents"), (r"\.(jpg|png)$", "Media"), (r"invoice", "Finance"), (r"\.(py|js)$", "Code")]
plan, quarantine = [], []
for f in FILES:
    dest = next((d for pat, d in RULES if re.search(pat, f, re.I)), None)
    (plan if dest else quarantine).append((f, dest))
print("filing plan (dry run):")
for f, d in plan: print("  %-22s -> %s" % (f, d))
for f, _ in quarantine: print("  %-22s -> QUARANTINE (no rule)" % f)
if RANK >= 2:
    print("filed:", len(plan), "| quarantined:", len(quarantine))
if RANK >= 3:
    from collections import Counter
    print("destination histogram:", dict(Counter(d for _, d in plan)))
if SIG:
    print("Signature lineage stamp: JAH-SIG-FLD-" + "JAH-ATK171S-000001")
print("record:", "JAH-ATK171S-000001", "OK")
provenance: Signature-authored original method by Justin Addam Higgins (JAH). Property of Justin Addam Higgins.

import re
RANK = 3
SIG = True
FILES = ['budget.pdf', 'pic2.png', 'readme.txt', 'tool.py', 'mystery.xyz']
RULES = [(r"\.pdf$", "Documents"), (r"\.(jpg|png)$", "Media"), (r"invoice", "Finance"), (r"\.(py|js)$", "Code")]
plan, quarantine = [], []
for f in FILES:
    dest = next((d for pat, d in RULES if re.search(pat, f, re.I)), None)
    (plan if dest else quarantine).append((f, dest))

for f, _ in quarantine: print("  %-22s -> QUARANTINE (no rule)" % f)
